What is this?

Write in Markdown. See it instantly. Present it live.

Inkwell is an in-browser Markdown studio. You type plain text on the left and watch it render on the right, then turn the same document into a full-screen slide deck, export it, or keep a whole library of notes — all stored locally on your machine. There is no account, no server, and no build step. Open index.html and it just works.

What's inside

Every piece is hand-built vanilla JavaScript. No Markdown library, no framework, no bundler.

A real Markdown parser

Written from scratch in js/markdown.js: headings, bold/italic/strike, inline & fenced code with a syntax tint, blockquotes, nested and task lists, tables with alignment, links, autolinks, images, and horizontal rules. HTML is escaped and unsafe URLs are blocked.

Live, synced preview

The preview re-renders as you type, with scroll synced to the editor and a live outline built from your headings. Click any heading to jump.

Presentation mode

Split the document on --- and present it full-screen — a reveal-style deck built by hand. Arrow keys move, a progress bar tracks you, Esc exits.

Export anywhere

Download raw .md, export a fully self-contained .html file with inlined styles, or open a print-friendly view and Save as PDF.

A document library

Create, rename, duplicate, and delete documents in the sidebar. Everything autosaves to localStorage and is sorted by most-recently edited.

Themes & focus

Light, dark, and sepia themes plus a focus / typewriter mode that dims everything but the line you're writing. Your preferences persist.

← → / EscNavigate / exit slides

Where your writing lives

Inkwell never sends your documents anywhere. They are kept in your browser's localStorage under the keys inkwell.docs.v1 and inkwell.settings.v1. Clearing your browser data clears your notes, so export anything you want to keep. If you open Inkwell in a private window, changes won't persist after you close it.
